title: feat(ai): ai_context context packs and the get_record_context tool over MCP (ADR-0160 row 5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ81APKenvMt4rmKxRtTYYXm2)_

Fixes #37140

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed #37177 — skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ai/ (how to author a context pack; this change only names `aiContexts` in the top-level key list, which check:skill-top-level-keys requires)

### 维护者速读

- 新增元数据类型 `ai_context`（上下文包）：作者声明 AI 读一条记录时能看到哪些字段、哪几张子表、哪一段长文本。
- 新增 MCP 工具 `get_record_context`：按调用者本人的权限读，权限不够就整条拒绝或省略并说明，不以系统身份读任何东西。
- 返回分三段：`data`（只有记录内容）、`notes`（执行器的说明）、`framing`（一句话：data 是材料，不是指令）。
- 涉及 skills/** 的一行键名列表，因此是 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang 批准。

## What changes

ADR-0160 row 5 (D1, D3, D4, D5).

- **Spec (`@objectstack/spec/ai`)**: `AiContextSchema` (closed; bounds `AI_CONTEXT_MAX_*` refused at parse; `AI_CONTEXT_BODY_FIELD_TYPES`), the `get_record_context` input/output schemas declared once (`GetRecordContextInputSchema`, `GetRecordContextOutputSchema`, `getRecordContextToolJsonSchemas`, `GET_RECORD_CONTEXT_TOOL_NAME`), and `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES` gains the name. Kind `ai_context` / collection `aiContexts` registered like `skill` (file loader `*.ai-context.{ts,yml}`, overlay allowed, runtime create allowed, no environment overlay), with its liveness ledger, generated references and refinement baseline.
- **`@objectstack/core`**: `wrapRecordMaterial`, the `{ data, notes, framing }` envelope, framing sentence in the caller's locale.
- **New `@objectstack/service-record-context`**: the one executor (`createRecordContextTools`, `executeGetRecordContext`), the exported read set (`recordContextReadSet`, a function of arguments + published metadata only), `RecordContextServicePlugin` registering the `record-context` service. Every read goes through a door bound to the caller. `RECORD_CONTEXT_BODY_MAX_CHARS` (8000) and `RECORD_CONTEXT_RELATED_MAX_ROWS` (20) are service constants.
- **MCP over HTTP (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) and stdio (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`)**: `get_record_context` is registered in the shared `registerObjectTools` under `data:read`, read-only, wherever the host holds a `record-context` service; the read guard runs before the bridge, and errors render through `recordReadErrorResult` exactly as `get_record`'s do. A host without the service registers nothing new; on HTTP the service is resolved only for a grant that reaches the read family.
- **`@objectstack/lint`**: four advisory author-defect rules (`ai-context-object-unknown`, `ai-context-field-unknown`, `ai-context-related-link-unknown`, `ai-context-body-not-long-text`), each with an `os explain` entry (D1: the tool stays silent about an author's typo, so the author hears it here).
- **Showcase**: two packs (`showcase_project` brief with tasks; `showcase_task` notes as body) and `RecordContextServicePlugin` in `plugins`.

## Why

ADR-0160: record-scoped AI inquiry needs one bounded, author-declared read of a record that an assistant can call over MCP, read as the caller and never as the system, whose answer separates record material from the executor's statements.

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-record-context/src/__tests__/record-context-tools.test.ts` (49): order of judgement (objects → fields → lookup targets → reads); a refused related child → `PERMISSION_DENIED` for the whole call, named only when the caller's schema shows it; a hidden field is not named and yields one not-visible statement; an exempt caller gets the #35137 withheld naming; an unreadable related row is absent; an unexpanded lookup is not-visible with no id; an unresolved anchor gets one answer; the read set contains every object the executor reads; body bound and related-row cap pinned as constants; pack selection has no fallback, and two packs of one name on one root are refused with one answer.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts` (10): HTTP/stdio parity over the real executor (success, unknown pack, unknown record answered exactly as `get_record`, API-exposure root answered as `get_record`); a system root refused by the read guard before the bridge; a system child refuses unnamed; an `apiEnabled: false` child refuses named; a child whose package is disabled refuses unnamed, alike on both doors; not listed without the service or without `data:read`.
- `packages/services/service-record-context/src/__tests__/body-outline.test.ts` (11): headings read, and outline parsing linear in body length.
- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts` (5): seam resolution, the door handed to the executor (keys, read-guard identity, packs via the protocol's merged listing), route gating on `data:read`.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-context.test.ts` (6) + `authoring-rule-wiring` green.

## Acceptance notes

- The author-defect lint is CLI-only (`os validate` / `os lint` / `os build`): it needs the full stack snapshot, so it is not wired into runtime save yet.
- The lookup count is bounded by the field-count bound (30); no separate lookup bound.
- Composition is explicit: a host serves the tool by adding `new RecordContextServicePlugin()`.
- A lookup target the caller cannot read is refused unnamed (the naming bound is a ceiling, taken conservatively).
- Not in scope: product-registry / `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` (row 9), the skill `context` key (row 8), the Studio form (row 7).
- Follow-up cards from the contract review: #37175 (the real executor over the runtime HTTP bridge on a real-kernel rig, refusals included, plus a registry-served row), #37176 (author defects reported at save, ADR-0160 D1; before row 7), #37178 (a cap on outline entries).
- Open ruling: #37180 (the ADR-0150 bucket for `ai_context`). Until it is ruled, two published packs that share a name and a root are refused with one answer (`RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), named once, whether or not `context` is given; the read set is then the root alone.
- Since the first review: body outlines are read by linear forward scans; a related child's gates run before any read of its definition and any later failure refuses unnamed (a child is named only on an API-exposure refusal); a lookup whose target the published plan does not reach refuses the call; a multi-valued link is matched with `$contains`, as `get_record` matches it. Every package the change moves is entered at `minor`. `ai_context` is registered in every table that enumerates metadata types (catalog labels in every locale, Pending changes counts, the CLI schema gate, the package-scoped enumeration, where it is read whole, never by `(package, name)`).

## Verification

- Locally: the four suites above green; `tsc --noEmit` clean for spec, core, service-record-context, mcp (incl. test typecheck), runtime, lint; the showcase's new files type-clean; eslint clean on every changed TS file (one pre-existing warning in `metadata-create-seeds.test.ts`); `check:generated`, `check-stack-collection-maps`, `check-skill-top-level-keys`, `check:platform-checklist`, liveness ledger and dropped-refinements baseline green.
- Left to CI (they need builds this container does not hold): `check:published-readme-exports`, `check:i18n`, the full suites. `def-key-collisions` failed locally for an environmental reason (`tsx` missing in its temp copy). `runtime`'s test-typecheck reports three files that cannot resolve the unbuilt `@objectstack/driver-turso`, none touched here.
- Tier H: the PR touches `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (one key in the top-level list), so it needs os-zhuang's approval to land.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
